================================================================================
Immediate identifiers may be followed by namespace delimiters
================================================================================
$::var::sub
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
General immediate regex stops before namespace delimiters
================================================================================
$var::sub
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
Namespace-shaped spelling remains a whole word outside variable syntax
================================================================================
var::sub
---
(program (word))

================================================================================
Whitespace before the immediate identifier is rejected
:error
================================================================================
$ var
---
(program (ERROR) (word))

================================================================================
Missing namespace component is rejected
:error
================================================================================
$var::
---
(program (variable (id)) (ERROR))

================================================================================
Unqualified immediate identifier
================================================================================
$var
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
Tcl single qualified component keeps its immediate identifier
================================================================================
$::var
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
Tcl deeper namespace keeps every immediate component
================================================================================
$::var::sub::leaf
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
Tcl namespace components may contain case underscores and digits
================================================================================
$::NS_2::value_3
---
(program (variable (id)))

================================================================================
A mixed-case namespace-shaped spelling is a word outside variable syntax
================================================================================
NS_2::value_3
---
(program (word))
